Step-by-step illustrations drawn from the finished pipeline outputs by `R/worked_examples.R`.
Nothing here feeds the analysis.

## Accepted charcoal-event detection

```{r}
show_figure('report/figures/worked_examples/fig_fire_event_detection_workflow.pdf', page = 1:2)
```

A charcoal record is interpolated, its background removed, peaks above the local noise threshold
become candidates, and candidates surviving the 75-year count screen become accepted events
(Appendix S2.2, Fig. S10).

## Climate eras: from signed changes to numbered eras

```{r}
show_figure('report/figures/worked_examples/fig_holocene_climate_period_method_worked_example.pdf')
```

Signed 1,000-year changes are computed in ten phase offsets, each variable is thresholded at 50% of
its maximum with at least eight of ten phases agreeing in direction, qualifying cells of any
variable are joined, and adjacent cells are merged into numbered climate-change and stability eras.

## Tracking geometry

```{r}
show_figure('report/figures/worked_examples/fig_method_worked_example.pdf')
```

One Panther Potholes lake-period: observed and climate-predicted movement, the lag before and
after, the tracking ratio and the angle.
